title: Generated Trimesh CollisionShape3D for a cube gets lost in the center of Area3D with CylinderShape3D
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducable in v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], 4.4.1, 4.3.stable ### System information Godot v4.5.stable - macOS Sonoma (14.7.8) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory ### Issue description This is gonna be a weird one. I was doing basic testing on setting up interactable items, and used a standard 1-meter cube, and generated the collision shape using the "Create Collision Shape" menu. Then I used an Area3D, with a CyllinderShape3D to detect it. I quickly discovered that the Area3D would emit `body_exited` when the StaticBody3D neared the center of the Area3D. I threw together a quick MRP and wound that the Area3D with a CyllinderShape3D with a radius < 2.0 will "lose" a 1 meter cube StaticBody3D when the body approaches the center of the CyllinderShape3D. The `body_exited` signal is emitted, and the cube is no longer listed in `Area3D.get_overlapping_bodies()`. In this video of the MRP, you'll see the cube enter the Area3D and turn yellow, but when it reaches the center, it will turn white because the `body_exited` signal has been issued. It will return to yellow as the cube exits the center of the cyllinder, then white when it actually exits the Area3D. After that I show the problem isn't present when the radius is 2.0. I then use the sliders to show that the issue is also present at slower speeds. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0684cfdd-83fc-43c2-933a-53766d9e4012 I played around a little more, and found that if I manually set a BoxShape, it works fine. Also, the other options for generating the collision shape work fine. This issue only happens with a Trimesh generated Shape2D. ### Steps to reproduce If you're using the MRP: * Run the scene * Move the radius slider to change the size of the Area3D cyllinder * values < 2.0 will show the cube exiting the Area3D when it approaches the center of the cyllinder * values >= 2.0 will not demonstrate the problem * Changing the duration slider speeds up how fast the Area3D ping-pongs * Changing this slider does not resolve the issue, so it doesn't look like a speed issue If you want to do things manually: To create the shape causing the problem: * Create a StaticBody3D * Add a MeshInstance3D child with the default Cube mesh * Use the Mesh -> Create Collision Shape; Sibilng, Trimesh To create the Area3D detector: * Create Area3D * Add CollisionShape3D with CyllinderShape, radius 1.75, height 2 ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [area-3d-body-exit-issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22703054/area-3d-body-exit-issue.zip)
